title: cistus populifolius subsp. major
intro: Cistus populifolius subsp. major, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose are attributed to its ability to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
